title: Rangers of the Wildwood
tagline: Sworn protectors of a living forest
description: Original fantasy-naturalist adventure: the learner is sworn as a Ranger of the Wildwood, defending a vast living forest by learning its ways. For learners who love nature, animals, and ranger fantasy.
worldPrompt: An original fantasy adventure as a Ranger of the Wildwood — a vast living forest that only reveals its secrets to those who understand it. Each subject unit is a ranger mission deeper into the Wildwood. Talking beasts (original), a Watchtower council, and a blight to outsmart.
